name: Each analysis paragraph is no longer than 600 characters
description: Analysis paragraphs should be concise and readable. No single paragraph in the analysis panel should exceed 600 characters to keep the content scannable.

planSteps.description: Click on any match bracket cell to open a match detail page
Scroll through the analysis panel to read all paragraphs

Verify that no single paragraph in the analysis panel appears excessively long. A paragraph exceeding 600 characters would visually appear as a very long wall of text taking up more than 5-6 lines on a standard viewport.
